## Core Capabilities
1. **8/20-Digit Exact Unique Invoice Number Deduplication**: Supports China's 20-digit All-Digital E-Invoices (数电票) and classic 8-digit VAT invoices. Never falsely flags same-amount rides/meals on different invoice numbers as duplicates, while 100% intercepting true duplicate invoice imports.
2. **Excel-Ready Reimbursement CSV Ledger**: UTF-8 BOM output with scientific-notation protection for 20-digit invoice numbers.
3. **Standard A4 300DPI 2-Up Print Layout**: Top & bottom halves (`2480×3508 px`), center horizontal dashed cut-line, and bottom claimant/department/total reimbursement summary bar.
